scientific_integrity: Analytic GF(2) periodic-image proof and finite matrix transfer; separate direct-energy exhaustive comparisons are reproducible via verify.py.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite periodic-state census and strictly one-flip blocked-state polynomial only; no dynamical hitting probabilities, positive-temperature lifetimes, or independently validated originality. A potentially relevant 1989 comparison was accessible only at abstract level.
title: Mod-three selection rules and exact blocked-state polynomial for the three-spin Ising ring
